scope: Bounded current primary facts for December 2026 BanRep no-change rule; no forecast, market prices, or decision.
rule_binding: Rate change vs pre-meeting level (upper bound if band); emergency non-meeting change excluded. Cancellation or postponement with no decision before next scheduled meeting maps No Change; qualifying postponement before next meeting follows that meeting.

current_primary_facts.fact: BanRep lists 12.25% effective 1 Oct after the 30 Sep +25bp decision. The scheduled 30 Oct meeting precedes the frozen 18 Dec meeting. Calendar displays 18 Dec 08:30–13:00 but supplies no timezone; minutes are listed for 23 Dec. No December result exists yet.

30 Sep vote: four +25bp, two hold, one initially +50bp then agreed +25bp. Majority cited inflation above 6%, expectations, demand/output, depreciation and El Niño/energy/fiscal risks; dissenters cited restrictive real rates and lags. This describes the prior decision, not December guidance.
current_primary_facts.source_capture: Existing 0379 facts unit; its minutes capture predates this addendum.

current_primary_facts.fact: Sep CPI released 7 Oct: headline y/y 6.29%; named core IPC excluding food and regulated prices 6.03%. Latest ISE is Aug, bulletin dated 19 Oct: seasonally/calendar-adjusted index 125.65, -0.11% y/y and -3.11% m/m; original Jan–Aug +2.27%. ISE is monthly activity, not GDP.
